# Quaternius Universal Animation Library

Project Emberfall uses selected clips from the Standard editions of Universal Animation Library 1 and 2.

- Author: Quaternius
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal; see each `License.txt`.
- UAL1 source: https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library
- UAL2 source: https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library-2
- Downloaded: 2026-08-27
- UAL1 archive SHA-256: `18FF1A7215F4852B320203E8AAF02A1578B5C8EEF9027FBAEDFCEDC7B85A3AC2`
- UAL2 archive SHA-256: `EC0E40D6D78FE9AAAD59E322F40865A8675C22F0745E291622E54520391A9217`

The FBX files in this directory are preserved as third-party source assets. Import settings, clip selection, Animator Controllers, project prefabs, and runtime adapters are generated or stored under `Assets/_Game`.

Project policy keeps Root Motion disabled: gameplay displacement remains owned by the CharacterController and deterministic combat model.
